name: Split Focus Ledger
prompt: High-fidelity desktop healthcare operations UI composition at 1440 x 900. Clinic software only, not the mentoring portal. Clinical Wayfinding Ledger direction: a professional high-trust clinical operations workspace using deep-sage navigation, white working surfaces, cool off-white canvas, dark slate-green text, restrained semantic color, quiet borders, and no gradients, glass, decorative illustration, playful motion, or ornamental shadows. Show Northfield Clinic and a Tracking Board with a compact context header, explicit freshness and bounded-data wording, a narrow workflow index at left with stage names and counts, and a dominant synchronized patient ledger at right. Preserve the reading order of patient, operational status and schedule timing, location and provider ownership state, reason and recorded care context, then explicit next action. Use 16px primary text, 14px secondary text, tabular numerals, sentence case, restrained tags, and dense-but-readable spacing. Late is operational timing, not clinical priority; missing and unrecorded states are explicit; no red/green acuity ladder. Option C: Split Focus Ledger, optimized for rapid operational filtering while keeping the record table primary.
